items.title: feat(rules): rule schema, YAML loader, --rules and test harness
items.body_excerpt:
## Summary

This PR builds the core of the rule engine for milestone M4. It loads rules from YAML, checks them, embeds the built-in rules in the binary, and adds `mcpmoat scan --rules <dir>` for extra rules. It also adds the test harness that makes `go test` fail when a built-in rule has no tests.

Rules are loaded and checked. They are not applied to scan results yet. The scan output is the same as before, and the "no rules applied" notice stays.

- **#33 Rule schema and YAML loader.** New package `internal/rules` with `Rule`, `Match`, `Case`, `LoadError`, `Validate`, `Parse` and `Set`. Decoding is strict. It adds one module, `go.yaml.in/yaml/v3` v3.0.5. The repo owner approved this module before it was added.
- **#34 Embedded rules and `--rules`.** Built-in rules are embedded with `go:embed` from a small root package, `rules/`. `rules/MOAT-T1-003.yaml` is the first built-in rule. The other rule issues add more. `mcpmoat scan --rules <dir>` adds extra `*.yaml` and `*.yml` files.
- **#41 Test harness.** `go test` fails when a built-in rule has no `should_match` case, no `should_not_match` case, no risk text or no remediation text. `CONTRIBUTING.md` documents the final format.
- **#32 `docs/competitors.md`.** Five tools, with a source link for every claim. `alexar76/warden` exists and is the closest competitor. The `mcp-lock` row is a best guess, because several repositories use that name. The document lists the other candidates.

Decisions the repo owner confirmed: the loader is lenient and the built-in harness is strict, test cases live inline in the rule YAML, and the competitor research uses the web.

Not in this PR on purpose:

- Regex compilation and matchers (#35).
- Native heuristics (#36).
- The ignore list (#40).
- More rules.
- Applying rules to scan results.

items.title: Add aimarket-oracle-gateway (verifiable oracle MCP server)
items.body_excerpt:
## Summary

Adds **alexar76/aimarket-oracle-gateway** to the **Security** section — a separate MCP server from our existing **Aggregators** entry (`aimarket-plugins` / mcp-packager).

MIT · Python · stdio MCP server exposing verifiable oracle tools for AI agents:
- **Platon VRF** — Ed25519-signed unbiasable randomness (`get_random`, `get_randomness_beacon`, `ask_oracle`)
- **Chronos VDF** — verifiable delay / proof-of-elapsed-time (`compute_vdf`, `verify_vdf`)
- **LUMEN reputation** — PageRank/EigenTrust trust scores (`get_reputation_scores`)
- `list_oracle_capabilities`

Pay-per-call over the [AIMarket Protocol v2](https://github.com/alexar76/aimarket-protocol); every result is independently verifiable. Fail-closed spend caps.

- Repo: https://github.com/alexar76/aimarket-oracle-gateway
- Glama: https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/alexar76/aimarket-oracle-gateway

## Test plan

- [x] Alphabetical placement in Security (after `alexfleetcommander`, before `alberthild`)
- [x] Distinct from existing `alexar76/aimarket-plugins` Aggregators entry (different repo, different purpose)

items.title: Repair observed AIMarket federation health checks and correct gateway payment documentation
items.body_excerpt:
## Observed blocker
Production HTTP logs on Oct 13 repeatedly show GET /ai-market/v2/health -> 404 from AIMarket discovery agents while /.well-known/ai-market.json and the manifest return 200. This PR adds a minimal, read-only, scoped health response to eliminate that compatibility error. No paid routes, payment policy, receipts, or credentials change.

## Documentation
The gateway README still described a deprecated Apify header-relay service. Replace with current direct x402/MCP surfaces, discovery paths, and safe Coinbase Base USDC recipient-verification instructions. Do not claim bot audits are customer revenue.

## Verification plan
Run npm run check; deploy only when CI/test results are green. Verify GET /ai-market/v2/health returns HTTP 200 in production, and paid route schemas and x402 challenge economics remain unchanged. Track whether independent funded buyer conversion changes rather than treating crawler hits as revenue.

## Spend
$0 discretionary acquisition spend; no self-purchases or third-party wallet signing.

items.title: Infrastructure gates, cross-platform checks, lessons, primer, and maintenance
items.body_excerpt:
## What's in this PR

**Infrastructure gates for AIMarket and Superset.** Following SmartTodo's pattern, the learner has the agent write a check script from a spec *before* any infrastructure exists (red), then generates until it passes (green), with a diff check proving the agent didn't edit the gate. Every rule is a real failure that `azd provision --preview` missed and `azd up` hit in a validation run.
- AIMarket: `Infrastructure Gate` section in `PLAN-phase4-azure.md`; README Phase 4 is now gate → generate → review → deploy → verify, plus a prompt for fixing a wrong gate as a new red commit.
- Superset: `.github/skills/superset-azure/config/infrastructure-gate.md`; README Step 3 writes the checks first.
- Validated with real runs: red before infrastructure, green after, deliberately broken rules caught (`ai-` prefix, `resourceId()` misuse, unquoted Helm setting, one-node cluster), and both deployments passed their unmodified verifiers.

**Cross-platform checks in GitHub.** New `portable-scripts` workflow runs `.github/scripts/test-portable-scripts.mjs` on ubuntu, windows, and macos runners (no Azure or Copilot credentials). Its first Windows run found a real bug in SmartTodo's checkpoint gate (fixed here).

**Lessons from validation runs** in Grafana, n8n, Superset, WeatherView, and AIMarket, like SmartTodo's.

**Agentic fundamentals primer** (`docs/agentic-fundamentals.md`): each technique, what it's for, and where to practice it, plus six habits from the runs. Linked from the root README.

**Journey problem issue form**, linked from "Getting help" and every journey's "When something fails" block.

**Maintenance**
- Dependabot skips the SmartTodo checkpoint snapshots (they caused the failing security-update runs).
- gh-aw updated to v0.89.21 and the harness recompi

items.title: journey-runner v2: full rerun of all six journeys, runner helpers, and fixes
items.body_excerpt:
Reran all six journeys end to end with the journey-runner skill (disposable repos and Azure environments, all cleaned up) and folded what the runs taught into the runner, the skills, and the journeys.

## Results

| Journey | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Grafana | PASS first try; dashboard created through the API |
| n8n | PASS first try; workflow built during `azd up`, webhook returned GitHub Zen |
| WeatherView | PASS after 4 prompt fixes; `/rewind` validated in a real session; deployed browser check caught a CSP bug |
| Superset | PASS after 2 failed deploys (skill fixes below); `/fork` validated |
| AIMarket | PASS; cloud agent PR, Copilot review, rebase conflicts, `/review` fixes; Phase 4 blocked by `715-123420` until the root cause was found |
| SmartTodo | PASS Phases 0-4 with a disposable repo; stacked PRs merged once from the top; cloud agent PR verified on Azure and macOS |

## Runner (journey-runner skill)

- New helpers: `extract-prompts.mjs` (README prompts word for word), `run-command.mjs` (lifecycle commands with timing), `summarize-run.mjs` (report tables with credits per session).
- `run-copilot-prompt.mjs`: `--agent`, `--mode`, `--resume-from`/`--session-out`, `--record`, `--allow-skill-dirs`, `--timeout-minutes`, `--usage-output-file` credits, `--secret-env-vars`, `--max-ai-credits`. Keeps Azure MCP on: under `-p` it serves `@azure/mcp` in `--mode all` with the 11 namespaces the journeys use, because the plugin's namespace mode needs MCP sampling, which prompt mode doesn't answer (github/copilot-cli#2882). Turns off `computer-use` (it drove the host's Safari). Sets `COPILOT_TASK_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3600` so an agent-run `azd up` isn't abandoned at 600 s.
- `capture-screenshot.mjs --password-env`; `check-prerequisites.mjs` accepts `xcodebuild`.
- SKILL.md

items.title: fix(factory): assign Copilot to existing issues
items.body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Replaces `create-agent-session` with `assign-to-agent` for existing approved factory issues.
- Restricts assignment to Copilot, one issue, and `main` as the PR base.
- Keeps dependency, WIP, issue-state, scope, and human-merge validation in the dispatcher prompt.
- Regenerates the lock file from the `.md` source with gh-aw v0.86.2.

## Why

GitHub’s public-preview agent-tasks endpoint returned HTTP 403 for a validated fine-grained PAT. Assigning Copilot to an existing issue uses the work order that already carries the factory contract and is the narrower authorization path.

## Verification

- `gh aw compile aimarket-factory-dispatch --validate --no-emit` — PASS, zero warnings
- `node scripts/verify-aimarket-factory-repo.mjs .` — PASS
- `node scripts/verify-aimarket-factory-local.mjs` — PASS, 18 policy fixtures
- Generated lock metadata reports compiler v0.86.2 and exposes `assign_to_agent`, not `create_agent_session`.

## Scope

Changed only:

- `.github/workflows/aimarket-factory-dispatch.md`
- `.github/workflows/aimarket-factory-dispatch.lock.yml`

No Azure resources or credentials were accessed.

Closes #28

items.title: feat(web): agent 双栏下 Dock 对齐到左对话栏底部

## 背景
承接 #282（agent 车道双栏外壳）。让底部创作 Dock 在 agent 双栏时对齐到左对话栏,形成"左侧对话式输入 + 右侧纯产物"的观感。

## 实现（低风险,不重排布局归属）
- `design-canvas.tsx`:新增 `onConversationPaneActiveChange`,在双栏实际渲染(agent+桌面+scroll)时上报激活状态;右产物栏底部内边距改为 `pb-6`,避免与浮动 Dock 无关的空白。
- `studio-workspace.tsx`:接收该状态,给 `StudioDock` 传 `alignLeft`。
- `studio-dock.tsx`:新增 `alignLeft` —— 浮动 Dock 由整宽居中改为对齐左栏宽度(`lg:w-[340px] xl:w-[380px]`,`justify-start`),focus 收起态同样左对齐。

保持 Dock 由 studio-workspace 单一挂载(浮层),不重复渲染、无 lane 状态下沉;移动端 / 图片视频 / infinite 维持整宽居中,零回归。

## 行为
- agent 车道 + 桌面 + scroll -> Dock 浮于左对话栏底部,右产物栏满高滚动。
- 其他场景 -> Dock 整宽居中(现状)。

## 不在本 PR
- 将 Dock 真正内嵌进左栏(非浮动、挤压内容)。
- 图片/视频车道的对话式 agent。

## 测试
- `pnpm --filter @aimarket/web typecheck` 全绿;lint 无新增告警。

items.title: feat(agent): P3.1 Checkpointer 与 API 重启续跑
items.body_excerpt:
## Summary

- **Sqlite checkpointer**：`AGENT_CHECKPOINTER=sqlite` 时使用 `@langchain/langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite`（需 `better-sqlite3` 构建）；失败回退 memory。
- **DB fallback**：`resumeAgentRunFromDb` — API 重启后 Memory/Sqlite checkpoint 丢失 interrupt 时，用 `agent_runs` + `state_json` 合并 Job 结果并推进下一步（含 VLM observe 重试逻辑）。
- **Runner 重构**：`graph-instance` + 启动时 `initAgentCheckpointer()`；`rowToInitialState` 恢复 `observations` / `stepRetries`。

## 配置

```bash
AGENT_CHECKPOINTER=memory   # 默认
# AGENT_CHECKPOINTER=sqlite
# AGENT_CHECKPOINT_SQLITE_PATH=./data/agent-checkpoints.sqlite
```

## Test plan

- [x] `pnpm --filter @aimarket/agent-core build`
- [x] `pnpm --filter @aimarket/api typecheck`
- [ ] CI + Integration + E2E
- [ ] 本地：创建 Agent Run → 重启 API → 待 Job 完成后应仍能 `completed`（DB fallback）

items.title: feat(agent): P3 VLM observe 与步骤质检重试
items.body_excerpt:
## Summary

- **VLM Provider**（`apps/api/src/providers/vlm`）：`mock` + 可选 `qwen-vl`（DashScope 多模态）；`AGENT_VLM_ENABLED=true` 时生效。
- **LangGraph `observe` 节点**：调用 `observeAgentStep`；质检失败且未超重试上限 → 回到 `execute_step` 重跑当前步；否则 `advance`。
- **Runner**：注入 `observeStep` / `maxStepRetries`；`state_json` 持久化 `stepRetries`。
- 文档：P2.6 ✅；P3 进行中；P3.1 预留 Redis checkpointer。

## 配置

```bash
AGENT_VLM_ENABLED=true
AGENT_VLM_PROVIDER=auto   # mock | qwen
AGENT_VLM_MAX_STEP_RETRIES=1
# Claude：AGENT_LLM_ALLOW_OVERSEAS=true 且 FALLBACKS 含 claude（已有 router）
```

items.title: feat(agent): P2.6 Skill Job 完成事件驱动续跑
items.body_excerpt:
## Summary

- `executeSkillRun` / `startSkillRunStep` 只创建当前步 Job 并置为 `waiting_job`，不再在 API 进程内 `waitForJob` 轮询。
- `notifyAgentJobCompleted` 增加 `resumeSkillRunOnJobCompleted`，在 Job 成功/失败后合并输出并启动下一步或标记 `completed`/`failed`。
- 抽出 `job-observation.ts`，避免 `job-events` ↔ `skill-executor` 循环依赖。
- 文档：P2.5 标 ✅，新增 P2.6 阶段说明。

## 为何现在做

#102 合并后 Skill 已可端到端跑通；本 PR 为 Inngest worker 与非阻塞 API 打基础（worker 不必占住连接等 3 步全部完成）。

## Test plan

- [x] `pnpm --filter @aimarket/api typecheck`
- [x] 本地 `node scripts/test-agent-skill.mjs` — 6/6
- [ ] CI + Integration + E2E

items.title: Add repo summary: DanWahlin/github-azure-agentic-journeys
items.body_excerpt:
Adds a repository summary for [`github-azure-agentic-journeys`](https://github.com/DanWahlin/github-azure-agentic-journeys) — a collection of end-to-end guided journeys for building and deploying applications to Azure using GitHub Copilot agents, Microsoft Foundry, and Bicep-generated infrastructure.

### Changes

- **`repos/DanWahlin-github-azure-agentic-journeys.md`** — New summary covering the 5 agentic journeys (AIMarket, n8n, Grafana, Apache Superset, SmartTodo), multi-language stack support (Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, Swift), and the Copilot agent → Foundry → Azure deployment workflow.
- **`repos/index.md`** — New entry under **Agent Frameworks & Design** linking to the summary with a short description and date.
